completion_gate: The source-derived adaptive transcript and quantifier order are explicit.
At most three materially distinct interfaces are typed or rejected at their earliest arrow.
Every interface has controls, method ceiling, exact cost accounting, and a scoped disposition.
No conclusion exceeds a zero-run proof/construction search.
constraints: No scientific, implementation, formalizer, benchmark, or parameter-selection run.
At most three interfaces across the three frozen lenses.
Use no hidden path, orientation, ideal, torsion label, tag, complete-ring data, or non-uniform per-query advice.
State every quantifier, output law, abort, retry, representation, degree, time, memory, and support obligation.
Do not design or claim a PKE.
handoff.objective: Reconstruct the exact adaptive bounded-OneEnd transcript and propose at most three materially distinct public-only coverage interfaces.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether any uniform interface answers every adaptive query with exact success, termination, representation, support, and polynomial total cost.
